opponent.label: Arueshalae
opponent.description: Known as "The Heretic Demon", Arueshalae is a succubus who has turned her back on her demonic heritage. She now aids the Fifth Crusade in its war against the infernal legions, hoping to find redemption along the way.

epilogue.description: For when you no longer want to be horny, just happy.
For when you haven't quite busted yet
